dct_description_sm: The purpose of this project was to: (1) to develop action plans for Tlicho governments, based on existing information and projections for future changes, that included short, medium, and long-term climate change adaptation and mitigation plans; (2) to ensure that climate change is incorporated into decision-making in Tlicho governments, institutions, and processes (for example, land-use planning); and (4) to implement as much of the action plans as possible. The first year of the project focussed on gathering information for workshops, engaging in public outreach, consulting with key stakeholders and community members, and initiating the community profile drafts.   The second year of the project focused on completing and finalizing the action plan drafts for community governments (in line with the first two overarching goals). In its third year, a focus was placed on implementing the community-specific climate change adaptation plans developed over the previous two years (for Behchoko, Gameti, Wekweeti, and Whati). The project aimed to implement the short-, medium-, and long-term adaptation strategies developed in the 2008-2009 and 2009-2010 phases, and to compile information to create the comprehensive Tlicho Government Climate Change Action Plan.

dct_title_s: Developing Climate Change Action Plans for Tlicho Communities and the Tlicho Government
